ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows the label “Algae” at the bottom center and “Small Fish” at the top center. A vertical arrow points upward from the algae toward the small fish. The labels “Insect” and “Frog” appear on the left and right, but they are not connected to algae by the visible arrow. Reasoning: The question asks what feeds on “algael,” which appears to be a typo for “algae.” In a food web, an arrow from a food source to an organism indicates that the organism at the arrowhead feeds on the source. Since the arrow goes from Algae to Small Fish, the small fish feeds on algae.
